newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says 70 pct of London Club debt reconciled.
newsitem.headline: Russia says 70 pct of London Club debt reconciled.

text.p: Russia has fully reconciled 70 percent of its debt to the London Club of commercial bank-creditors, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.

"According to the Ministry of Finance and Vneshekonombank, more than 340 of Vneshekonombank's London Club creditors have now returned signed Reconciliation Statements confirming that 70 percent of the aggregate amount of eligible debt has been reconciled," the ministry said in a statement in English. Russia has to reconcile 90 percent of the $24 billion principal of its $35 billion total debt, inherited by Russia from the Soviet Union after its breakup, to close the agreement.

The statement said that Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov confirmed that Russia did not intend to ask the London Club to cut the 90 percent threshold of the volume of debt necessary to close the rescheduling agreement.
Market rumours said Russia planned to ask to reduce the limit to 75 percent at a meeting with London Club officials earlier this week.
